lessons.lesson: The post-install deployment patch described by ADR 0023 raced first process start. Gate process start on complete configuration rather than treating a later patch as initialization.
lessons.evidenceLimit: ADR narrative is retrospective failure evidence; no contemporaneous run log was collected.
alternativesAndRejections: Post-install patching was rejected for the observed timing race.
Chart values/init containers, upstream changes and rendering adaptations must be assessed before workload-specific admission.

lessons.lesson: Prefer a suitable upstream chart and isolate UDS configuration. TAK-specific Pepr watching is not a universal packaging default.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Alternatives marked R in the ADR are retrospective reasoning, not tested comparative results.
alternativesAndRejections: A fork increases drift but can be justified if upstream is unsuitable.
A renderer can handle manifests but not later cluster-state reconciliation.
The ADR names a Zarf 0.89.0 post-renderer limitation; it is not assumed for other tool versions.

lessons.lesson: Review secret/CA rotation and missing-input failure behavior independently from static declaration presence.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Inspected declarations and documentary claims do not establish a rotation result.
alternativesAndRejections: Static secret references do not prove reload behavior.
An admission controller needs narrowly bounded selectors and explicit outage behavior.

lessons.lesson: Test the actual authenticated non-HTTP transport without assuming TLS clients send SNI.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Test source was inspected; no network handshake was run.
alternativesAndRejections: A browser/OIDC success does not establish streaming transport success.

lessons.lesson: Record exact privilege, architecture, mesh and network exceptions with rationale and narrow scope. Virtual-device evidence cannot stand in for physical-device behavior.
lessons.evidenceLimit: ADR limitations are source-reported; no KubeVirt/physical device was deployed.
alternativesAndRejections: Do not apply privileged KubeVirt or ambient-mesh exceptions to unrelated workloads.

lessons.lesson: Inventory images/charts, build inputs, init/exporter/upgrade-only images and runtime external calls. Test with disconnected egress; export is not proof.
lessons.evidenceLimit: No package build or disconnected execution was run.
alternativesAndRejections: An exported package alone cannot demonstrate offline application operation.

lessons.lesson: Keep platform/application versions separate. Platform guidance recommends intermediate validation, pre-upgrade backup and staging; platform rollback is not officially supported. A Completed object backup with snapshotVolumes false does not establish volume-data protection.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Version-pinned guidance was inspected; no upgrade, backup or restore was performed.
alternativesAndRejections: Do not infer application downgrade safety from platform guidance.
Do not equate restored objects with restored application data.

lessons.lesson: Compare packaging workflows with existing agent-facing MCP/API tools. The presence of MCP alone is not novelty or deployment authority.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Reference documentation inspected; no Epinio instance was started.
alternativesAndRejections: Epinio is a comparison baseline, not a required backend.

lessons.lesson: Bind validation to exact inputs/tools/profile and verify producer identity, approval freshness and execution authority separately from structural receipt shape.
lessons.evidenceLimit: Conduit-native validation requirement; normative packaging text does not establish a receipt protocol.
alternativesAndRejections: An unsigned shape-valid report cannot self-issue approval or be promoted into a trusted integration result.
